acquirer.name: PIMCO RAE Worldwide Long/Short PLUS Fund

listed_quote.quote: a Delaware statutory trust and an open-end management investment company

announcement.quote: announcing the Board of Trustees’ approval of submitting to PIMCO EqS ® Long/Short Fund shareholders a proposal to reorganize the PIMCO EqS ® Long/Short Fund with and into the PIMCO RAE Worldwide Long/Short PLUS Fund.

deals.notes: Open-end (mutual fund) series reorganization; target CIK 1479360 is the trust PIMCO Equity Series, acquirer CIK 810893 is the trust PIMCO Funds. Excerpts do not state how it ended (last filing 2019-11-21 is a pre-vote solicitation about reaching quorum).
